final_operational.failed: A read-only closeout-template inventory attached a pipeline directly to a PowerShell foreach statement and failed at parse time.
final_operational.recovery: Materialize the loop rows in an array, then pipe the completed array to the formatter.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Never attach a pipeline to an unparenthesized PowerShell foreach statement.

final_operational.failed: A second read-only file-existence inventory repeated the same direct foreach-to-pipeline parser fault and earned zero credit.
final_operational.recovery: Use only the materialized-array form for the rest of the phase and retain the repeat as a distinct failed witness.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Treat a recovered parser signature as a locked method constraint for all later PowerShell probes in the phase.

final_operational.failed: The first mechanical template adaptation used a PowerShell hash whose case-insensitive keys made distinct Tamar/tamar replacements collide; the command was rejected before writing any file.
final_operational.recovery: Represent replacements as an ordered array of explicit key/value pairs and apply them sequentially.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not use PowerShell hash literals when replacement keys differ only by letter case.

final_operational.failed: A combined stale-label search containing mixed encoded punctuation failed PowerShell quote parsing before execution.
final_operational.recovery: Split the audit into bounded literal pattern groups and keep encoded punctuation out of shell expressions.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Use single-purpose literal searches for stale labels and exact patches for encoded text.

final_operational.failed: A second combined search again included unsafe encoded-character patterns and failed at PowerShell parse time.
final_operational.recovery: Remove encoded literals from shell search expressions and inspect the known file regions directly.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: After one encoded-search parser fault, use exact file patches rather than retrying equivalent combined shell patterns.

final_operational.failed: The first multi-file closeout patch was atomically rejected because one prepared route-context line did not match the exact local file.
final_operational.recovery: Reread the exact local blocks and apply smaller independent patches.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Never widen or retry a rejected patch without an exact context reread.

final_operational.failed: A second multi-file patch was atomically rejected when a displayed mojibake form did not match the file's actual UTF-8 Māori text.
final_operational.recovery: Separate ASCII-safe structural edits, inspect UTF-8 text with escaped diagnostics, and patch the exact Unicode source.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not build patch context from a console's mojibake rendering.

final_operational.failed: A read-only Python repr diagnostic failed while printing Māori text through the Windows cp1252 console.
final_operational.recovery: Pin PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 and use ASCII-escaped diagnostics when examining uncertain console encodings.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Set explicit UTF-8 process encoding before every later Python validation or text diagnostic.

final_operational.failed: A combined stale-label search, Python compile, and Git status probe exceeded its wait window and returned no attributable aggregate result.
final_operational.recovery: Verify no process or lock remains, then isolate the stale-label search, AST syntax check, and bounded Git state checks.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine repository scans, compilation, and Git status in one timed terminal cell.

final_operational.failed: The first recovered stale-label audit treated the generic word console as a superseded-practice marker and matched retained Windows console encoding failures.
final_operational.recovery: Classify the contextual hits and narrow the scanner to domain-specific superseded-practice tokens.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not use a generic operational word as a stale-domain marker without context classification.

final_operational.failed: The narrowed stale-label audit matched only the retained N19 failure description because that record repeated the superseded domain token.
final_operational.recovery: Preserve the failure semantics without repeating the stale token and classify retained-negative records separately from live labels.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: A stale-label scanner must distinguish retained historical failure descriptions from current executable or reader-facing labels.

final_operational.failed: The first closeout process monitor combined Wait-Process with log-tail reads and exceeded its wrapper without returning a snapshot.
final_operational.recovery: Leave the independent builder untouched and query only exact process existence before any log read.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine process waiting and D-drive log reads in one bounded monitor cell.

final_operational.failed: A second closeout monitor combined a sleep with D-drive log tails and also exceeded its wrapper.
final_operational.recovery: Remove sleeps and log reads from monitoring; use a scalar process probe and inspect logs only after the process exits.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: After a monitor timeout, reduce the next monitor to one scalar state question.

final_operational.failed: The first final log read serialized PowerShell content objects with provider metadata instead of emitting the bounded text line.
final_operational.recovery: Read the completed log as raw text or coerce each content row to a plain string before JSON serialization.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Never place provider-backed Get-Content objects directly inside a deep JSON diagnostic payload.

final_operational.failed: The first hidden final-commit launcher split the multiword commit message into pathspecs, so Git rejected the command without creating a commit.
final_operational.recovery: Preserve the staged index, rebuild receipts with this failure retained, and invoke Git with one exact quoted argument string.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Verify Start-Process argument boundaries for any multiword Git commit message before launching.

final_operational.failed: A later scalar process monitor still combined a ten-second sleep with PowerShell startup and exceeded its forty-five-second wrapper.
final_operational.recovery: Remove the sleep entirely and use immediate process-existence probes.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: On this D-drive lane, process monitors must not include sleeps inside the timed shell cell.
